text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Visiting President of Andalucia Manuel Chavez Gonzalez aims at helping Morocco stretch an economic bridge to Europe.
- Justice Minister Abderrahman Amalu says Morocco made substantial headway over human rights.
- Alarming rates of illiteracy hamper economic growth in Morocco.
- Rainfall which started in the north expected to spread to central parts of Morocco, giving hope for a good agricultural year.
- Six die and 14 are injured in a road accident between Casablanca and Rabat.
- Heavy rains might endanger the poor infrastructure of cities and cause new catastrophes.
- New impulse to Spanish-Moroccan cooperation after visit of Andalucia president.
